entries.zh: 忧思重重、心神不宁（思虑萦怀）
entries.notes: 页首 L 栏残损，据残形与 M 复原为 pensamiento；H 栏另注「惦惦」异读。

entries.zh: 便利齐全、备办停当（随手可用）

entries.en: prompt and time-saving; done in good time
entries.notes: H「省時節」非经见成语，义依 L「a tiempos（及时）」与三字连读定。

entries.en: quick in dispatching business; swift and decisive
to presume; to act presumptuously on one's own
entries.notes: L 后半「¿ vano.」及右侧溢写残损，义以「Presumir」与 H「擅」互证。

entries.en: to boast of one's greatness; to give oneself airs
entries.notes: 「品頭皮」字面为品评人物皮相，与 L 义仅间接相应。

entries.en: to fancy oneself learned; to pose as wise
entries.notes: H「筆頭毒」字面谓笔下刻毒，与「presumir de sabio」不密合，释义以 L 为主。

entries.en: to take liberties; to act at one's own convenience
entries.notes: L 末「govierna bien」与 H「擅便」不相应，取「presumir／擅」义。

entries.en: haughty; holding no one in regard
entries.notes: 上行西语为墨线划去之重复，本行 H／M 完整可读。

entries.en: self-important; full of one's own dignity
entries.notes: L 末「va No」残缺，义据「presumptuoso」与 H「自重」定。

entries.en: self-willed; acting on one's own without leave
entries.notes: L 中段「amigo se a…aparece」残损，义以「presumptioso」与 H「自專」为据。
L 后半「amigo se supa|roer」窜乱难读，然「presumptuoso」与「自負」互证明确。

entries.zh: 图谋名位尊荣（原词第二字污损，待考）
entries.en: to aspire to dignity or rank (second character damaged)
entries.notes: H 第二字污损（饌／餒异读）、M 声调标记 T99 不可辨，仅 L 义可定。

entries.en: to aspire to greatness; lofty and high-spirited ambition
entries.notes: H 首二字「惺惺」间夹小字（疑乙／Ζ）待考，主干「志氣」与 L 相合。

entries.en: lofty and imposing in bearing; high-spirited
manly ambition; the aspiration of a great man
